players.product: High-cap MLCCs (CC/AC series, incl. KEMET line) for PDN decoupling

quarterly_data.signal: Q2 2026 results deck (company document, filed with the call): net sales NT$44,456 million, up 35.7% YoY; gross margin 38.5% (+0.4ppts QoQ, +2.9ppts YoY), which the company attributes mainly to price increase and favorable AI product mix, partially offset by higher input cost and demand for standard products; EBITDA margin 32.3%; EPS NT$4.59 (NT$4.81 excluding the retained-earnings tax provision; 1H26 EPS NT$8.48, NT$8.70 excluding it). By product: tantalum +14.1% QoQ and +44% YoY; MLCC and resistor growing faster than total due to strong demand on both standard and specialty products. By segment: weakness in PC adversely impacting Computing & Enterprise; industrial growing for 6 consecutive quarters; positive momentum on automotive. The deck cites positive sentiment and outlook from customers for 2H26.
